I gently remove my fingertips from the mirror.
“How was it, Miss Lapraud?”
“……It seems this mirror isn’t meant to see through to where that person is right now.”
……What I caught a glimpse of must have been his past.
It does make me feel a little sad.
But just because he’s pitiful doesn’t mean I can condone his actions.
(……I have to stop that person.)
One day left until the festival’s final day.
Cronne, which I created with all my heart as an amateur, has just been completed.
And then...
We had gathered in the Portail Bleu lounge after clearing the area of people.
“Everyone, thanks for all your hard work so far. Yuris and I will take the completed Cronne to the cathedral tonight.”
“Thank you so much for all your help…!”
Leon smiles and nods.
“If you try hard enough, things will work out. Let’s keep this up and finish everything tomorrow, too.”
“There’s no way nothing’s happening tomorrow, right? I mean, come on…”
Jack shrugs his shoulders and gives a wry smile.
“Well, I’m actually looking forward to it, too.”
“Oh, Evan…”
We’ve done our best to prepare, but…
Of course, it’s best if there are no issues at all.
“My Schatz. You, too, should get a good night’s sleep tonight to prepare for tomorrow.”
“Yes… Thank you.”
We wrap up the discussion and adjourn.
As I watched the outside world turn the colors of dusk, I was thinking, “ Maybe I’ll just take my time heading home,” but...
Suddenly, someone tugged at the hem of my shirt, snapping me back to reality.
“! …Ahès?”
“……I…… I want to see the ocean.”
“The sea?”
I thought for a moment, then nodded.
“Sure. Let’s go together.”
By the time he walked from Vil to the sandy beach, stars had begun to twinkle in the sky.
Is it just my imagination?
She seemed somewhat unsettled.
……After stomping on the sand for a while.
“Um, well….”
She opened her mouth as if finding it hard to speak.
“It was me who called you to the island.”
When I was told that, it strangely made sense to me.
I don’t think Ahès’s words are lies.
Also...
“This year, before I came to the island—”
“Have we met before?”
……I kind of had a feeling that was the case.
I clearly remember having met a girl who looked just like her.
I’m now certain that person must be a blood relative—or at the very least, not just a case of mistaken identity.
“……I summoned you to this island to break your curse.”
“……But I… I like Aria, so—”
“……But I… [主人公]—I like you, so—”
She cut herself off as if hesitating.
Then, without looking at me, he muttered as if letting the words slip out.
“……Don’t leave. ……From now on, I want you to stay with Mirage forever……”
That voice sounded lonely and desperate.
But...
“……I’d like to take just a little more time to think about whether I’ll stay on the island.”
I can’t possibly decide in just these three weeks.
……That was how I honestly felt at that moment.
“I have nowhere left to go, and no family waiting for me.”
“Even if I were to become a resident of this island, and could never leave for the outside world again.”
“I also feel like living in Mirage, which I’ve always longed for, might actually be nice.”
“But….”
Ahès is looking at me with a worried expression.
“……Because it’s a choice with no turning back.”
“If I just make a random decision and end up regretting it… I might end up hating Ahès.”
“……I don’t want it to turn out that way, so I want to think it through carefully before making a decision.”
“……Hey, Aria…….”
She says, as if forcing the words out.
“Do you like me?”
In response to her question, I—
I like it.
What's wrong?
“Yeah. I like Ahès.”
“I’m sure everyone feels the same way.”
She smiled as if relieved.
“Why are you asking that?”
She stammers, as if finding it hard to speak.
“……If I were to…….”
“If I were lying, what would you think…? Would you start to dislike me?”
Ahès looks up at me anxiously.
“Well… that depends on what kind of lie it is.”
“……What do you mean, ‘what kind’……?”
“If you hate me and are trying to frame me —if those were lies you told—I don’t think I could ever forgive you.”
Think carefully and speak your honest feelings.
“But that’s not it—if there’s a reason, and it’s a lie I can accept…”
“I don’t think I’ll ever be able to hate it.”
“……Really?”
"Yeah."
That was a feeling free of any lies or pretense, though.
A hint of inner conflict flickers in her eyes.
“……I want to stay with everyone forever.”
“……But Aria and I aren’t ‘the same’……”
“……But I and [主人公] aren’t ‘the same’……”
“Is it the same…?”
She also seemed to be afraid of something.
I choose my words carefully when communicating.
“I don’t really understand what Ahès is worried about.”
“I think it’s very difficult to say exactly what’s different and what’s the same, though…”
“Just because we’re different doesn’t mean I’ll stop liking you.”
“……Yeah.”
……The sea was terribly quiet that night.
That morning, I woke up without having had any dreams.
……Finally, it’s the last day of the festival.
In the end, we were unable to find Xeno’s whereabouts.
As a second-best option, lie in wait for him at the mausoleum.
However, since there’s a possibility that Xeno might choose a different location for the ritual…
Led by Yuris, the Administration Bureau agents were scattered throughout various parts of the island.
――It was almost noon.
Xeno has appeared.
“……Did I keep you waiting?”
He doesn’t seem surprised by the gaze directed at him.
“I’ve been looking for this place for a long time. I thought it might have sunk into the sea…”
“A few days ago, an entrance suddenly appeared. I realized then that I was definitely being invited.”
Xeno is holding only one original book.
The book’s design was unlike anything I had ever seen before.
“I won’t let you get in my way. There’s no way you could. Not you guys, who don’t even have the original book.”
He is looking down on us.
That came across even in that mocking gaze.
“……Why do you want to end the world?”
What does “The World Will End” mean? How will the world come to an end?
Even now, it was still unclear where his wishes were leading.
“You yourself won’t get off scot-free either. Yet, why――”
“Of course, I have no intention of escaping on my own. My wish is for everyone to be equal—and for us all to lose everything.”
“To lose everything….”
“Hehe… As for how I’ll make you lose it, I’ll figure that out together with ‘him’ from now on.”
He――
I wonder if Xeno has any collaborators.
The faces of the people I’ve met so far—those who belong to the cult—flit through my mind.
“Shall I spread a plague across the world? Or shall I make stars rain from the sky and split the earth?”
“It might actually be nice to watch a civilization—one stripped of human intelligence and simply falling apart —from afar.”
Before he could finish speaking.
The magical power overflowing from the original book shimmered ominously, drifting around him as a dark, mist-like haze.
“Hmm…!”
(This is the power of having all three original books...)
That magical power has clearly increased compared to before.
“You—just one single person—have no right to trample on the world.”
Rudy said coldly, then swung his rapier, creating a wind blade.
However, before that shockwave reaches Xeno, it is deflected by the darkness.
Rudy’s expression grows even more stern.
Jack calmly raised his gun and quickly pulled the trigger, but—
That bullet is blocked by Xeno’s darkness and vanishes without a sound.
“……Physics is completely disabled.”
“I’d like to say it’s a case of ‘outnumbered,’ but once I have all the original books, it doesn’t look like it’ll be that easy.”
Charles wraps the dagger he has drawn in light.
As he stepped forward lightly, it wasn’t Xeno himself, but that sliced through the area around him.
As if aiming for the slightest crack in the darkness――
Leon fired a shot.
A bullet grazes his arm, and Xeno’s face twists slightly.
(It arrived...!)
“The world you’re wishing for is boring. It’s not even beautiful……”
“I’m sorry, but I can’t go along with that.”
Charles boldly steps forward once more and slashes through the darkness with a dagger glowing with light.
“Hmm…!”
Seizing the moment when the Dark Guardian’s defense faltered, Leon fired his gun again.
But it couldn’t squeeze through the tiny gap, and the bullet vanished into the darkness as if swallowed up.
“Your aim’s a little off…”
Xeno smiles mockingly.
Leon showed no sign of flinching and retorted.
“What do you expect from a weapons merchant? You, of all people. If you used the original book, you’d know that something as simple as a lead bullet should be easy to block—”
“How on earth did you get injured? Aren’t you being too careless?”
While mocking Xeno, who is bleeding from the earlier sniper shot, Leon continues to fire.
“……This is so annoying……”
Xeno frowned.
A black darkness spilling from the original book writhes, attempting to completely obscure his figure.
“……I don’t want to keep you waiting any longer ……”
I, too, do my small part by manipulating water—
He made the water orbs burst one after another around Xeno.
It was just a technique meant to distract the enemy—it had absolutely no lethal capability.
Caught off guard, he froze.
At that moment, a bullet fired by Leon grazed Xeno’s cheek.
The next sound I heard was the gunshot from Jack.
The carefully aimed shot slips through the gap between the darkness and strikes Xeno’s shoulder.
“Guh…!”
Blood gushed from the shoulder wound where the bullet had pierced it, quickly soaking his clothes red before his very eyes.
“Just a little more… just a little more…”
Seizing the moment, Rudy presses his advantage with another wind spell.
Slowly but surely—
We were closing in on Xeno.
But...
“……That’s strange.”
Evan lets out a quiet, ominous mutter.
“The power of the original text—and especially that of its complete form— cannot possibly be like this…”
――That’s right.
Now that you mention it, Xeno is purely on the defensive and shows no signs of making a move.
Leon and the others seemed to have noticed that something was off as well; a hint of wariness was evident in their expressions.
“Huh… ahaha…!”
Suddenly, Xeno bursts into laughter, his shoulders shaking.
Immediately afterward.
In an instant, the darkness spread throughout the entire mausoleum, as if it were being stretched out ――
Trapped in that darkness, we are completely unable to move.
It’s not powerful magic that harms people.
It felt like a restraint that, if I took my time, even I might somehow manage to break free from.
For Charles and the others, it probably won’t take even a few seconds .
But...
“Do you think I came into today without any preparation? I’ve long since finished the groundwork to wake ‘him’ up.”
“No magic circles or magical artifacts were needed. All that was left was to call out to ‘him’ right here.”
Without even pretending to care about his injury, he says.
“The ancient god of Canaan. Called a demon by the church, he was never granted to Cornuaille, and was sealed at the bottom of the sea—”
“……It was you who was calling me!”
Just then, Xeno let out a cry of joy.
――The original book vanished from his hands.
“Huh…?”
At the same time, the darkness that bound us will vanish.
“I can’t imagine putting the original book away in this situation. If that’s the case…”
――Did the original book vanish after granting a wish?
Xeno’s appearance looks distorted.
A shadow burst forth from at his feet, taking the shape of something that looked just like a hideous tentacle.
Suddenly, the air around me grew heavy, and it became hard to breathe.
It’s as if I’m sinking underwater—I can’t even breathe .
“You’ve been calling for me all this time… It took me a while to come see you.”
“Were you bored being trapped here? …But things are going to get fun from now on.”
“Let’s destroy the world just as we wish. Now, lend me a hand.”
He stands alone, speaking into the void.
“It sounds like they’re talking to someone…”
“Well, given the circumstances, the opponent is probably a dark god— something that Xeno was trying to summon.”
“……The original book’s gone, too. Honestly , this is a development I really don’t want to believe……”
Xeno turned his gaze toward her and smiled slyly.
“……You guys won’t even be able to lay a finger on me anymore.”
“……You guys won’t even be able to lay a finger on me anymore.”
As if he were absolutely certain of it, Xeno possessed a strangely calm composure.
The ominous aura from earlier—the magical power he unleashed through the original book—has now subsided.
Since the original book has disappeared, he should be nothing more than a flesh-and-blood sorcerer ...
Something seems out of place.
It’s as if something we can’t see is there…
An indescribable sense of foreboding. There was something there that could only be described as a sense of unease.
“……That’s not good……”
Charles grips the glowing dagger once more.
Is he testing how Xeno appears? Just like before, he closes the distance as if dancing.
……But at the same time, a dark-colored tentacle lashed out.
Charles’s eyes widen.
The moment one of the tentacles touched the dagger, the light on the blade vanished as if it had been sucked away.
Suddenly, the tentacles that had been bouncing around unnoticed come crashing down sharply, one after another.
Just as the tentacles were about to touch him, Charles parried them...
That expression looks pained.
Trying to provide support, Rudy released another gust of wind.
But it was silently swallowed up by the darkness swirling around him—
Immediately afterward, Rudy’s body is blown away after being struck head-on by a sharp, dark blade that had been deflected back at him.
“—Rudy!”
“You don’t have time to be distracted by others, do you?”
Xeno’s mocking voice echoes.
Leon reloads his gun and fires.
But no matter how many times the bullets hit, it doesn’t seem to have any effect …
“Hmm…!”
Conversely, struck hard in the darkness by something like a tentacle, Leon drops his gun.
“……Do you have too much power on your hands?”
“I’m sorry. With a body like mine, I’m probably too small to serve as a vessel, aren’t I?”
Xeno flashes an eerie smile and speaks to someone.
I try to recall what I was taught before.
It’s easier to manipulate the water that’s already there from the start than to use water you’ve created yourself.
“Hmm…!”
Concentrating, he attempts to slice through the darkness with a thin, sharp, razor-sharp blade of water.
I felt like I was starting to get the hang of it.
But immediately afterward—
The water blade is swallowed up by the undulating darkness and vanishes.
“I think I’m finally getting the hang of this… I guess I’ll call it a day for now.”
Xeno murmurs cheerfully and flashes a twisted smile.
(――This might not work)
There’s no sign that the situation will improve.
A single drop of despair falls within my heart, casting a shadow.
The next issue that arose was――
It was Jack.
The throat is sunken in an unusual shape.
It resembled a strange shape, as if it were being squeezed in someone’s hand.
Yet no one can call out his name or rush to his aid.
It’s definitely not that I’m chicken—
An invisible darkness is enveloping our entire bodies.
I’m being squeezed so tightly that I can’t breathe properly, and I feel like I’m about to lose consciousness.
(……I’m lucky, so……)
I’m sure everything will work out just fine.
No matter what happens, everything will be okay in the end.
(……I’ve always believed that. I’ve made myself believe it.)
(But……)
If you’re really lucky, you won’t be on a sinking ship.
I haven’t lost my family either.
……I’m not even caught up in a battle like this.
“The power of Aria’s feelings is something special.”
“The power of [主人公]’s feelings is something special.”
“The stronger your desire, the more likely your wish will come true.”
(But, Grandma……)
――I know.
No matter how much I wished for it, Dad died.
No matter how earnestly one prays, human wishes cannot compete with something greater than that.
(……I’m not lucky at all.)
(I don’t have anything……)
If I had admitted that, my legs would have gone weak, and I felt like I wouldn’t be able to move anymore.
"I'm fine," he said.
"I'm just lucky," he said.
I’ve just been telling myself that all my life.
“You’re a good person. At least I’ll kill you painlessly.”
Xeno’s eyes are staring at me.
His expression was twisted and distorted; he seemed like a completely different person from who he used to be.
The swarm of tentacles growing at Xeno’s feet, with clear intent to kill—
It’s aimed at me.
“Hmm…!”
I feel a heavy impact in my chest.
The very next moment, I couldn’t breathe anymore.
I can’t breathe.
Suddenly, I looked down.
There’s a huge hole in my chest—
The world went dark.
There was a faint movement of air.
Feeling that, I looked up—
Something like a membrane of water faintly enveloped us.
Xeno, standing outside the water, doesn’t even twitch, as if time itself had come to a standstill.
“Huh…?”
You notice a figure appearing in a place where no one should have been just a moment ago.
It’s different from usual.
Not just the outfits, but even their physical appearances.
But I definitely recognize that look in their eyes.
“Ae, Su…?”
Or perhaps――
“Ahès is fine. I like the way it sounds when you call me that.”
“……To be honest, I didn’t want anyone to see that.”
“I’m afraid to reveal my true identity. As a human, I want to stay by everyone’s side. …But….”
“Aria told me, ‘ Just because it’s different doesn’t mean I’ll stop liking you.’”
“[主人公] told me, ‘ Just because it’s different doesn’t mean you have to hate it.’”
She gazed at me gently and said that in a soft voice.
Suddenly, the membrane of water surrounding us bursts.
“! I see…”
Xeno’s voice conveyed both surprise and conviction.
“So this woman is Dayu, huh? The Tyrannical Princess. The woman who sealed you away…!”
With words that were neither anger nor excitement, Xeno glared at Ahès.
“……My powers have been usurped. Even my faith has been stolen from me lately.”
“But now that you’ve awakened, the seal that was holding me down has loosened…”
“I have a little more freedom, too. I can help people out more than usual.”
Xeno, having obtained the power of the Evil God, wields the tentacles of darkness.
Multiple tentacles closed in on Ahès, but she spread Rin right in front of her to block them.
From the water’s surface, which served as a shield, something like a rippling water tentacle reached out—
As the water tries to sweep away the dark mist that seeks to capture Xeno, the dark tentacles begin to rage.
Her magical power, like a surging wave, overflows, attempting to swallow him whole along with her tentacles.
“Am I going to let you do that…!?”
The two sides were evenly matched.
……At least, that’s how it seemed at first.
Gradually, the darkness swells, and Ahès is pushed back.
At that moment.
Having regained his freedom of movement, Rudy swung his rapier, striking the wind.
“Don’t butt in like that…!”
Xeno frowns in annoyance.
With a gesture as casual as brushing it away, the shockwave Rudy unleashed was neutralized, but...
"The battle isn't over yet!"
“Rudy…”
His dignified voice echoed through the mausoleum.
Jack drags his body—which looks as if it might collapse at any moment—to its feet.
“Well, I guess I can’t just sleep while the kids are working so hard… ”
“Jack…”
His eyes are quietly fixed on Xeno.
“……It was incomplete until just a moment ago. But now, it’s different.”
Xeno snapped in a harsh tone.
But...
“The right opportunity will definitely come…”
“Evan…!”
Even as he sat up halfway, the look in his eyes showed that he had never given up.
#stillreplay_06oth_07
“……Aria. It’s not like you to just keep crouching there like that.”
“……It’s not like you to just keep crouching there like that.”
“Leon……”
My childhood friend’s words were harsh, but they hit the nail on the head.
……Leon is right.
We are still alive.
It’s a waste to give up while there are still things you can do.
Ahès, who had been staring at Xeno, turns to look at me.
And then, he held out his hand.
“……Aria. Let’s go together.”
“……[主人公]. Let’s go together.”
Ahès’s voice is both gentle and stern.
“Humans were the ones who awakened it. Therefore, humans must do something about it.”
“All I can do is lend a hand, so…”
“……Yeah.”
With resolve, I nodded in response to those words.
Take the small hand that’s been extended to you firmly.
“Ahès, lend us your strength. Let us once again put the Evil God to sleep…!”
Everyone is here for me.
If everyone supports me, I can get back on my feet.
Ahès clasped my hand in return and turned her gaze toward Xeno.
The presence of the magical power eroding him grows ever stronger.
I am about to transform into something that is not human――
It even gives off a sense of foreboding.
“……Let’s go back to the bottom of the sea. You will continue to sleep from now on.”
Through Xeno, she calls out to the being inside him.
When Ahès turned her palm toward him, it felt as though the atmosphere in the mausoleum had lightened just a little more.
“Madame and Monsieur… This is the stage!”
A resonant voice rang out—at that very moment.
A dazzling rose-colored light burst forth from the ground at Xeno’s feet.
“……You’re the best, Charles Paradille!”
There is an uncontrollable excitement hidden beneath her usually calm voice.
“Huh…!? I… can’t move…!”
It was a trap set by Evan.
“Rituals designed to seal away otherworldly beings, or to weaken their power, exist all over the world.”
“You could say that’s only natural.”
“After all, the ability to fight against non-human beings is what has kept humanity alive until today, isn’t it?”
Over the past few days, we have been making certain “preparations.”
At the heart of it all was――
Evan is well-versed in a wide range of folklore.
Also, thanks to an introduction from the Administration Bureau, Serge—who is well-versed in the rituals and the legends of Sirène—lent a hand as well.
“……What’s this?”
“It is rose salt. Moreover, it is produced from the Eastern Mountains, renowned as the dwelling place of snow and the Mother Goddess of the World.”
“It’s pretty hard to come by, though… Fortunately, I was able to buy the one they were using at the restaurant.”
The fact that they’re using something like that in cooking… That’s Mirage for you—a high-end resort.
“Mix salt and iron powder, and start by drawing a circle on the ground.”
“Since iron is a substance that symbolizes ‘human order,’ the fairies absolutely hate it.”
“Place <dic=201> carnelian </dic> inside the circle according to the star’s coordinates.”
“Since there are many jewelry stores on this island, this was easy to come by.”
“The red stone is the noble prince—the symbol of the evil god. We are now drawing a formation to seal it within the circle, aren’t we?”
In addition, while using multiple materials such as gold dust, in the end,<dic=905> the rune characters </dic> were engraved.
“All that’s left is to channel magic into this circle to activate it. It should be perfect in theory, but….”
“If it were just a demon, it would be easy to capture , but to be honest, I’m not sure how effective that would be.”
The opponent is a being who is, in a roundabout way, even called a god.
“I’ll cast a concealment spell. You can only use this once. There won’t be a next time.”
“Please conserve your resources until you see your opponent let their guard down or show signs of exhaustion.”
“Well, we’re trying to fight a god with human magic, after all. Under normal circumstances, we wouldn’t stand a chance.”
“Please ask a skilled mage to cast this spell.”
“The power of a magic circle depends not only on the materials but also on the caster’s power.”
“Well then… Mr. Rochefort?”
“……No, I think there’s someone more suited for this than me. Don’t you agree?”
Rudy turns around.
The person at the end of his gaze playfully shrugged his shoulders before flashing a relaxed smile.
“……That’s a huge responsibility, isn’t it?”
While the Magic Circle’s support continues.
“……Now’s the time, Aria.”
“……Now’s the time, [主人公].”
Nods and casts a spell.
The water I control swells like raging waves, pushing back the darkness with the force of a raging torrent.
It’s clear this isn’t just my own doing; I can feel myself being propelled by a tremendous magical power.
Darkness and the sea clash, sending two-colored shards flying all around.
I’m sure I wasn’t mistaken—it definitely felt like I was the one who started pressing .
“Why… why, why!”
“Why does everyone—every single one of them—keep getting in the way of my wishes…!”
In response to his cry, magical power surged forth.
The seal is being pushed back.
Ahès’s facial expression changes slightly.
――I had a gut feeling that this wasn’t right.
“Ahès, please. Is there anything else I can do!?”
“I’ll give you everything I have. If that’s what it takes to stop him…!”
“Aria, no!”
“[主人公], No good!”
“Fräulein! You shouldn’t be proposing such a deal to something that isn’t human—”
Ahès stares at me and says quietly.
“……I’ll grant your wish.”
“……You are special. Your clan has also sacrificed a great deal.”
“But I have to collect my payment.”
A soft light enveloped me and her.
“Ah—”
As if the lights suddenly went out.
I am enveloped in a deep darkness, like the bottom of the ocean.
The sounds around me faded away, and suddenly, it felt as if I alone had been left behind, all by myself.
――I can’t breathe.
I scratch my chest, overwhelmed by a suffocating sensation of floating and distress.
At the same time――
I feel like something is slowly slipping away from within me.
It felt like an eternity to me, but in terms of time, it was surely just a moment.
When I look up, everything is exactly the same as it was just a moment ago.
Ahès is right in front of me. And everyone is looking at me with concern—
There is a Zenno with an anguished expression on his face.
“This is the end.”
Prompted by her words, I hold out my hand.
A torrent of light spilling from his fingertips struck Xeno as a formless wave.
An untouchable sea of magic envelops him.
“Stop it, please stop…!”
Xeno begins to be swallowed up, from the ground all the way to the bottom of the sea.
His face contorted with anger, and he glared at us.
Those eyes look like those of a child on the verge of tears.
"Damn it...! Don't mess with me!"
A pair of eyes burning brightly stare intently at me.
A mist like darkness gathers in his hand, taking shape into something.
Right after I felt that overlooking this would be dangerous.
Leon’s bullet weaved through the mist and pierced his hand.
“Guh…!”
The moment pain broke Xeno’s concentration, a wave swept over him in rapid succession.
I wield the waves by my own will.
As I overwhelmed Xeno with waves so powerful they were impossible to resist, I let out a short breath.
I cannot save him—the one who tried to destroy the world.
But I felt like reaching out to help.
Those feelings weren’t a lie either.
――And then――
When the sun touches the sea.
People began to gather at the Great Cathedral of Mirage.
The ceremony marking the end of the festival has fewer travelers in attendance than on the first day.
Perhaps due to the time of day, there seem to be a particularly large number of children among the people of Vil.
As a result, it felt less like a stiff, ceremonial event and more like a very idyllic gathering.
Our swapped Cronne went unnoticed by anyone—
Thrown into the fire by Rudy, it is solemnly offered to Sirene.
The people gathered around the burning wreath sang and danced to an unfamiliar Breton nursery rhyme.
“……It’s done.”
“Hmm…”
We gazed at the orange light that never faded.
“By the way, is the young lady all right? How are you feeling…?”
“Nothing in particular so far….”
“What Xeno awakened was the entity that had cursed Aria.”
"What Xeno awakened was the one who had cursed [主人公]."
“I was trying to revive myself using the prayers I’d accumulated so far. But I failed. Now that I’m sealed away, I have no power.”
“……What does that mean?”
“So, at least for a while, no matter what happens, I won’t be able to return from the bottom of the sea— is that right?”
She nodded slowly.
“And the curse of a powerless being has no effect.”
“Is that…?”
“……Does that mean her curse has been lifted?”
"Yeah."
My heart is filled with relief and joy.
On my behalf—since I was at a loss for words—Charles gently asked her.
